rubrics.text: when going to sleep on the right side
sailors as soon as they go ashore
warm room from the open air
must rise up and bend head backwards
as if the next would be the last
diseased conditions of distant parts not involved in act of breathing
approach the mouth as it will cause dyspnea
with head bent forward on knees amel.
to left side disappeared on sitting up
on level ground but not when ascending
becomes deathly pale and must remain quiet
entering warm room from open air
stupefaction and crying out as with a sharp pain
